Intel: chunk multi-function Rust source into pieces

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"chunk_max_size\":30,\"language\":\"rust\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "fn alpha() {}\n\nfn beta() {}\n\nfn gamma() {}\n\nfn delta() {}\n", config: configObj)
debugPrint(result.language())
debugPrint(result.metrics().totalLines())
debugPrint(result.chunks())
```
